skills.name: hax-site-structure
skills.description: Read and navigate an existing HAXcms site from its portable files: site.json, pages/, files/, theme, basePath, wc-registry.json. Load FIRST when an agent lands on any HAXsite or deployment.

skills.name: hax-content-authoring
skills.description: Author HAX page HTML with valid HAX-capable web components and DDD attributes. Use when writing or editing pages/, choosing input, icon, button or media components, or creating pages via the hax CLI. Keeps content portable and editable in the HAX editor.

skills.name: hax-managed-files
skills.description: Know which HAXcms files are generated (rebuild, never hand-edit) versus authored. Load before editing a managed file or running a build: no ubiquity script, no top-level monorepo build, local hax CLI instead of npx.

skills.name: hax-design-system
skills.description: Apply the DDD (Design, Develop, Destroy) design system and manage SimpleColors legacy usage. Use when styling components, auditing CSS for DDD compliance, migrating from SimpleColors, creating new themes, or building admin surfaces (site admin, outline-designer, system admin) with HAX UI, DDD's admin layer.

skills.name: hax-a11y-audit
skills.description: READ-ONLY WCAG 2.0 AA audit of authored HAX pages (alt text, headings, landmarks, contrast, captions, keyboard, ARIA) with HAX remediation. Use for "is this accessible" or "audit for WCAG". Diagnoses only; hands off to hax-site-building.
